title: Good Morning
description: NCERT Class 3 English (Marigold): 'Good Morning'. New words, comprehension, naming words (nouns), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Good Morning': morning, sky, breeze, greet.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Good Morning' mean (morning, sky, breeze, greet); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A gentle wind is called a ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: Good morning, dear sun and sky.
The tree and the bird are naming words.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Good Morning' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Good Morning'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The poem greets the sun, the wind, and the ___.
The poem says good morning to the sun, the wind, and the ___.

exemplars: Good morning, dear sun and sky.
The tree and the bird are naming words.

nodes.title: Naming Words (Nouns)
nodes.teach_focus: A naming word names a person, place, animal, or thing: sun, tree, bird, school.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses naming words (nouns) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of naming words (nouns).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which word is a naming word?
A ___ sings sweetly in the morning.
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: The sun, the tree, and the bird are naming words.
My school is near the river.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Good Morning'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Good Morning': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Every morning I say good morning to my ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A ___ sings sweetly in the morning.
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: Good morning, dear sun and sky.
The tree and the bird are naming words.

items.prompt: A gentle wind is called a ___.
The poem greets the sun, the wind, and the ___.
The poem says good morning to the sun, the wind, and the ___.
Which word is a naming word?
A ___ sings sweetly in the morning.
